# Log File Genius

> Portable project context for humans and coding agents, stored in Markdown and Git. Shared AGENTS.md instructions, a Claude import, and optional Google Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.2 metadata.

## Installation

Install the distributable `main` branch as `.log-file-genius/` in an existing Git repository. The `development` branch contains internal project records.

```bash
git submodule add -b main https://github.com/clark-mackey/log-file-genius.git .log-file-genius
bash .log-file-genius/product/scripts/install.sh --ai-assistant generic --profile solo-developer
```

The automated path requires Python 3.10+. Windows uses `install.ps1 -AiAssistant generic -Profile solo-developer`.

## Context contract

Read STATE, follow all applicable ADR routes, and reconcile recorded evidence with the checkout. Maintain logs for meaningful changes and handoffs. Do not invent verification, assume complete context, or use documentation as a concurrency lock.

The installer merges a compact block into AGENTS.md and configures a Claude import. Existing .agents skills and .claude settings remain user-owned. Codex, Claude Code, Pi, Warp, Orca, and Hermes use the shared records through their native entry conventions; host behavior still needs verification in the actual session.

OKF is optional and scoped to a selected knowledge bundle. The producer preserves unsupported YAML and reports incomplete migration. It is not a general-purpose OKF consumer or an attestation service.

Run the CLI from the consumer project root: `python3 .log-file-genius/product/scripts/lfg.py --help` (Windows: `python`). Read Markdown directly when Python is unavailable. Do not copy development notes into a consumer project.
